title: Excellent City, Wonderful Tours
text: Absolutely amazing tour! Both guides were extremely knowledgeable, kind, interesting, and funny. I give professional tours in my home city and study Islamic art and architecture, I can tell you these guys are great. Our guide’s restaurant recommendation for lunch was also excellent. Just skip the eggplants, ask for the lunch deal with steak for 20 Euros. Definitely purchase the Cordoba mosque ticket. The buses have usb ports, bring your cable, because your phone will run out of battery after taking so many beautifulpictures 🤪
